strings.name: Michael O’Leary
strings.summary: O’Leary expanded Ryanair’s low-cost model through standardized aircraft, intensive utilization and ancillary revenue. Cheap fares came with stripped-back service, fee disputes and labour pressures. Ryanair CEO from 1994, he became Group CEO in 2019; in 2026 the company agreed to extend his contract to 2032.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Advanced Ryanair’s low-cost model, changing European short-haul competition and travel consumption.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Castlemagner, County Cork; grew up near Mullingar, Ireland.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied business and economics at Trinity College Dublin, followed by accountancy-firm training.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Low-cost operations
strings.highlights.h1.text: Combined cost control, fleet standardization and ancillary income to expand affordable travel.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Group and labour relations
strings.highlights.h2.text: Leads multiple airlines while balancing collective bargaining and operating efficiency.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Contract extended to 2032
strings.timeline.t1.text: Board announced renewal; new share options remain subject to employment and performance conditions.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Fiscal 2026 ended
strings.timeline.t2.text: Annual report records over 208 million passengers and €2.17 billion after-tax profit for the group.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Became Group CEO
strings.timeline.t3.text: Moved from Ryanair CEO to oversight of a multi-airline group.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Recognized trade unions
strings.timeline.t4.text: The company accepted collective bargaining, changing its longstanding labour approach.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Acquired Buzz Stansted
strings.timeline.t5.text: Added the business and airport slots to its operating resources.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Initial public offering
strings.timeline.t6.text: The holding company completed its IPO, supporting European expansion.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Became Ryanair CEO
strings.timeline.t7.text: Led the low-cost transition, fleet standardization and route growth.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Became chief financial officer
strings.timeline.t8.text: Entered core management as CFO and an airline director.
